acceptance: Preserve the asymmetric C/foice silhouette accepted in V2, without a solid filled stripe
Each V4 sprite has genuine element-specific geometry rather than recolored copies
Negative space and clean separated blades/particles; no thick filled rainbow-like C
Native 144x144 per frame for V4, 12 frames and indexed transparency
V1/V2 byte-for-byte unchanged; Phaser/WebGL uses version-specific frame sizes
No merge, game integration, or approval until user visually accepts the new effects
referenceObservation: Frame 4.76s of the user-provided 1080x1920 video: sparse C-shaped rotating slashes, large negative space, disconnected ember shards, separated cyan crystals, hairline white wind blades, leaves and luminous motes. Shapes reinterpreted, not traced or copied.
